rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: At the sitting of Tuesday 21 October 2008 the Speaker announced that the President had informed her that he had appointed 'the Deputy President, Ms B Mbete', as Leader of Government Business in the National Assembly under section 91(4) of the Constitution 'with effect from 6 October 2008'. Earlier in the sitting the Minister of Finance referred to 'their Excellencies President Motlanthe and Deputy President Mbete'.

locator.heading: APPOINTMENT OF DEPUTY PRESIDENT, MS B MBETE, AS LEADER OF GOVERNMENT BUSINESS (Announcement)

rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: In the same sitting the Minister of Finance expressed his appreciation to 'former President Mbeki and former Deputy President Mlambo-Ngcuka'.
